==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am on a rocky blue alien planet. The name of the planet is Thraxor. The creatures here resemble purple skeletal golems that walk on all fours.

The creatures are extremely hostile and fast. You'd imagine that being made of stone would make them much slower. But they move like cheetahs.

I am accompanied by a hunter resembling a blonde Viking with cybernetic arms. The hunter demonstrates their cybernetic weapon systems. With an incredible discharge of electricity, they effortlessly eradicate the hostile golems.
